filters.name: title
filters.description: Job title keywords, OR'd: a person matches if their title contains ANY of them (case-insensitive), e.g. ['vp sales', 'head of sales'].

filters.name: title_exclude
filters.description: Drop people whose title contains ANY of these, e.g. ['assistant', 'intern'].

filters.name: title_whole_words
filters.description: Match title and title_exclude as whole words: 'cto' finds 'CTO' but not 'Director'. Short single-word values (4 letters or fewer) always match as whole words.

filters.name: company
filters.description: Company name contains ANY of these (case-insensitive), e.g. ['stripe'].

filters.name: company_exact
filters.description: Match company names exactly instead of 'contains', so 'meta' does not also find 'Metallica'.

card.unit: micro-USD is 1/1,000,000 of a dollar; each price is also given in USD

prices.what: fetch by id, minimum per call

formulas.lookup_charge: keys matched * hit price for the key type (up to 5 people per key included) + keys not found * miss

notes: A search that finds nobody is still charged its scan units.
A search or count too broad to run is refused before it runs and charged nothing.
A lookup key returns at most 5 people, all covered by its one hit.

paging: Pass next_cursor back as cursor; null means the last page. limit 1-1000.
location: city, state and country are the COMPANY headquarters, not where the person lives. The country/state/city filters filter by company location too. country and state are accepted as aliases of countries and states.
